lines.en: label karindate15:
I tap on Karin’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我点开手机里 Karin 的名字，等着她接。

lines.en: It’s that weird part of the afternoon between lunch and dinner where I want to eat, but having four meals in one day is kind of frowned upon.
lines.zh: 正是午餐和晚餐之间那个尴尬的时段——我想吃东西，可一天吃四顿总归不太像话。

lines.en: But I’m sure if I told Karin that, she wouldn’t mind.
lines.zh: 不过我相信，这事要是跟 Karin 说了，她不会介意的。

lines.en: Maybe the two of us could go out for lunch or something?
lines.zh: 要不我们俩出去吃顿午饭什么的？

lines.en: That sounds like a thing she’d enjoy.
lines.zh: 听起来像是她会喜欢的事。

lines.en: Sure, she’ll probably drop her phone when I ask, but I think she’d enjoy it when all is said and done.
lines.zh: 当然，我一开口她大概会把手机摔了，不过我想到最后她还是会开心的。

lines.en: : Hello! I mean...hi!
lines.zh: : 你好！我是说……嗨！

lines.en: : Hey!
: All three of those mean the exact same thing, Karin. Any of them will work in the future.
lines.zh: : 这三个词意思完全一样，Karin。以后随便用哪个都行。

lines.en: : Okay but “hello” is too formal and “hi” is too informal and if I accidentally added an extra y to “hey” you would have thought I was too clingy.
lines.zh: : 可是“你好”太正式，“嗨”又太随便，而且要是我一不小心把“嘿”说成了“嘿～”，你又会觉得我太黏人。

lines.en: : Are these things that girls actually think of?
lines.zh: : 这些真是女孩们会去想的东西吗？

lines.en: : Greetings! H...How are you today?!
lines.zh: : 幸会！你、你今天怎么样？！

lines.en: : Hungry.
lines.zh: : 饿了。

lines.en: : Do you...
: Do you want me to make you lunch?
lines.zh: : 要不要我给你做午饭？

lines.en: : Or...dinner, I guess?
lines.zh: : 或者……晚饭，我猜？

lines.en: : It's that weird part of the day between the two, so I don’t really know what to call it.
lines.zh: : 现在正好是两者之间那个尴尬的时段，所以我也不知道该叫它什么。

lines.en: : I was actually wondering if you’d maybe want to go out to a diner or something?
lines.zh: : 我其实在想，你要不要出去吃点什么，比如去个小餐馆？

lines.en: : Ah! D-Diner?!
lines.zh: : 啊！餐、餐馆？！

lines.en: A loud bang rings out through my cell-phone, signaling that Karin has, just as I expected, dropped the phone upon being asked out.
lines.zh: 手机里传来一声巨响，说明 Karin 正如我所料，在被约出去的瞬间把手机摔了。

lines.en: She’s so pure.
lines.zh: 她真是太单纯了。

lines.en: : S-Sorry! My hand slipped!
lines.zh: : 对、对不起！我手滑了！

lines.en: : I had a lot of coffee today and...um...hands.
lines.zh: : 我今天喝了好多咖啡，然后……呃……手。

lines.en: : Right...
lines.zh: : 好吧……

lines.en: : So, what do you say?
lines.zh: : 那么，你觉得怎么样？

lines.en: : I’d love to!
lines.zh: : 我愿意！

lines.en: : Great, then-
lines.zh: : 太好了，那——

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 不过……

lines.en: : Uh-oh.
lines.zh: : 哦嚯。

lines.en: : My parents are expecting a package and they asked me if I could sign for it when it gets here.
lines.zh: : 我爸妈有个包裹要收，他们让我到时候签收一下。

lines.en: : Can’t Kirin do it instead?
lines.zh: : 不能让 Kirin 代签吗？

lines.en: : I..don’t know where she is.
lines.zh: : 我……不知道她在哪儿。

lines.en: : But, umm...
lines.zh: : 不过，呃……

lines.en: : Maybe if...
lines.zh: : 说不定……

lines.en: : If you wanted to...come over?
lines.zh: : 如果你愿意……来我家的话？

lines.en: : I...I wasn’t really joking when I offered to make you lunch...or dinner.
lines.zh: : 我……我说要给你做午饭……或者晚饭，其实不是开玩笑的。

lines.en: : Which one did we decide this was again?
lines.zh: : 我们刚才决定管这顿叫什么来着？

lines.en: : I don’t think we did.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们没定。

lines.en: : But if that’s really okay, I’ll start heading over now.
lines.zh: : 不过要是真的没问题，我现在就过去。

lines.en: : Okay! Yeah! I’ll...um...
: I’m gonna take a shower and get dressed then.
lines.zh: : 那我先去洗个澡换身衣服。

lines.en: : You...you know where I live, right?
lines.zh: : 你……你知道我家在哪儿吧？

lines.en: : Yeah. I’ve met Kirin there before.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我之前在那儿见过 Kirin。

lines.en: : Right...right. Yeah. Okay!
lines.zh: : 也是……也是。嗯。好的！

lines.en: : Umm...just...call me when you get here, then!
lines.zh: : 呃……那……你到了就给我打电话！

lines.en: : I’ll see you soon!
lines.zh: : 待会儿见！

lines.en: The two of us hang up and I begin to make my way over to the Kanda residence.
lines.zh: 我们俩挂了电话，我开始往神田家走去。

lines.en: It will be the first time I’m hanging out with Karin alone in the apartment, and I fully expect it to be disastrous in the cutest possible way.
lines.zh: 这将是我第一次和 Karin 单独待在公寓里，而我完全预料到，这会以最可爱的方式演变成一场灾难。

lines.en: scene karinsushi1
Karin lets me in after I text her about my arrival. And, before I know it, we’re awkwardly standing in the living room, staring at each other.
lines.zh: 我发短信说到了之后，Karin 让我进了门。等我反应过来，我们俩已经尴尬地站在客厅里，大眼瞪小眼。

lines.en: : So...umm...did you find the place okay?
lines.zh: : 那个……呃……你顺利找到地方了吗？

lines.en: : Yup. Didn’t I just tell you earlier that I remembered where you live?
lines.zh: : 嗯。我刚才不是才说过，我记得你家在哪儿吗？

lines.en: : Y-Yeah...but my mom always talks about how boys can be forgetful, so...I thought maybe you’d...you know...forget.
lines.zh: : 是、是啊……可我妈总说男孩子有多健忘，所以……我想也许你会……你知道的……忘了。

lines.en: : She could just be saying all of that to justify how my dad forgot their anniversary this year, though.
lines.zh: : 不过她说这些，也许只是为了给我爸今年忘了他们的纪念日找借口。

lines.en: : Well, it’s true that my memory is probably one of the worst you’ll ever find, but it’s for reasons entirely unrelated to anniversaries and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我的记性大概确实是你见过最差的之一，不过原因跟纪念日什么的完全无关。

lines.en: scene karinsushi2
: What’s...what’s wrong with your memory? Is it okay for me to ask that?
lines.zh: : 你的记忆……出了什么问题？我可以问这个吗？

lines.en: : Let’s just say a lot of it disappeared.
lines.zh: : 这么说吧，有很大一部分消失了。

lines.en: : And I guess the rest of it could technically disappear again...but only at several really specific moments.
lines.zh: : 而剩下的那些，严格来说也可能再次消失……只不过会发生在几个非常特定的时刻。

lines.en: : Like when seasons change or something.
lines.zh: : 比如季节更替什么的。

lines.en: : I don’t really understand how it works, to tell you the truth.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我自己也不太明白这是怎么回事。

lines.en: : Is that...some sort of...disease?
lines.zh: : 那是……某种……病吗？

lines.en: : No, it’s more like-
lines.zh: : 不，更像是——

lines.en: scene karinsushi3
: I...I’ll take care of you!
lines.zh: : 我……我会照顾你的！

lines.en: : You don’t need to worry, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 你不用担心，老师！

lines.en: : I’ll wait by your bedside every morning and show you flashcards to remind you of who I am! And who everyone else is!
lines.zh: : 我每天早上都会守在你床边，给你看识字卡片，提醒你我是谁！还有其他人是谁！

lines.en: : You don’t have to worry! Everything will be okay!
lines.zh: : 你不用担心！一切都会好起来的！

lines.en: : I appreciate the offer, but I’m pretty sure I’ll be fine.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你的好意，不过我很确定我不会有事。

lines.en: : Please continue to spend your mornings working out or whatever else it is that you do.
lines.zh: : 你还是继续把早晨花在锻炼，或者别的你常做的事上吧。

lines.en: scene karinsushi4
: I...watch the news sometimes?
lines.zh: : 我……有时候会看看新闻？

lines.en: : While you’re working out, I’m guessing?
lines.zh: : 我猜是一边锻炼一边看？

lines.en: : ...Maybe.
lines.zh: : ……也许吧。

lines.en: : Well, in the event that my memory {i}does{/i} randomly disappear again, I’d love for you to come remind me of who I am.
lines.zh: : 那么，万一我的记忆{i}真的{/i}又突然消失了，我很乐意你来提醒我我是谁。

lines.en: : You’ll probably have to fight off a small girl with red hair who will be attempting to do the same exact thing, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你大概得先打发掉一个红头发的小个子女孩——她也在打算做一模一样的事。

lines.en: scene karinsushi5
: But I don’t want to fight Ami...she’s so nice.
lines.zh: : 可我不想跟 Ami 打架……她人那么好。

lines.en: : Maybe we can just take turns?
lines.zh: : 要不我们轮流来？

lines.en: : Or I can just...cook for you while she reads you the flashcards.
lines.zh: : 或者我可以……在她给你念卡片的时候给你做饭。

lines.en: : I still want to make them, though. I have this weird thing where I just really like flashcards for some reason.
lines.zh: : 不过卡片我还是想做的。我有个怪癖，就是不知道为什么特别喜欢识字卡片。

lines.en: : Do you want to talk more about flashcards? That sounds fun, right?
lines.zh: : 你想多聊聊识字卡片吗？听起来很有意思，对吧？

lines.en: : It sounds...like a thing.
lines.zh: : 听起来……像是一件事情。

lines.en: : I’m more interested in the part about you cooking.
lines.zh: : 我更感兴趣的，是你做饭那部分。

lines.en: scene karinsushi6
: Oh! Right! That’s why you’re here!
lines.zh: : 哦！对！你就是为了这个来的！

lines.en: : Look! Table!
lines.zh: : 看！桌子！

lines.en: scene karinsushi7
I “Look. Table.” to find that Karin has laid out two surprisingly large sushi platters.
lines.zh: 我顺着那句“看！桌子！”看过去，发现 Karin 已经摆好了两大盘寿司。

lines.en: And when I say “surprisingly large” I mean both the platters and the actual pieces of sushi are gigantic.
lines.zh: 我说的“大得惊人”，是指盘子和寿司本身都大得离谱。

lines.en: I was all about the idea of a fourth meal today, but...this might be a little too much.
lines.zh: 我本来对今天吃第四顿这事挺来劲的，不过……这好像有点过了。

lines.en: : So, umm...I’m sorry for not asking you what you wanted.
lines.zh: : 那个，呃……抱歉，我没先问你想吃什么。

lines.en: : If you hate it, we can just order from somewhere.
lines.zh: : 要是你不喜欢，我们可以叫外卖。

lines.en: : Actually, let’s just do that right now. This clearly isn’t good enough for you.
lines.zh: : 其实，我们现在就这么办吧。这些对你来说显然不够好。

lines.en: : I’m sure it’s fine, Karin.
lines.zh: : 我觉得肯定没问题，Karin。

lines.en: : Oh! And...umm...I didn’t know what you would want to drink, so I just got you...one of everything we had.
lines.zh: : 哦！还有……呃……我不知道你想喝什么，所以就给你……每样都拿了一份。

lines.en: : Is that canned coffee?
lines.zh: : 那是罐装咖啡？

lines.en: : Yes!
lines.zh: : 是的！

lines.en: : Do you normally drink canned coffee with sushi?
lines.zh: : 你平时吃寿司配罐装咖啡？

lines.en: : No!
lines.zh: : 不是！

lines.en: : Oh God...I’ve ruined everything.
lines.zh: : 哦天哪……我把一切都搞砸了。

lines.en: : I’m so sorry, Sensei. I’ll just get my phone and-
lines.zh: : 真的很抱歉，老师。我去拿手机，然后——

lines.en: scene karinsushi8
: It's fine, Karin. There’s no reason to order takeout when you’ve already done this much.
lines.zh: : 没事，Karin。你已经做了这么多，没必要再叫外卖了。

lines.en: : I’m not drinking the canned coffee, though.
lines.zh: : 不过那罐装咖啡我是不喝的。

lines.en: : I’m no gourmet, but that doesn’t sound like it would be a good flavor combination.
lines.zh: : 我又不是什么美食家，但那组合听起来实在不怎么样。

lines.en: : Are you sure you don’t want a pizza or something?
lines.zh: : 你真的不想要个披萨什么的吗？

lines.en: : I want to eat what you made.
lines.zh: : 我想吃你做的东西。

lines.en: scene karinsushi9
: Are you sure?
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？

lines.en: : Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : But what if I’m not good enough?
lines.zh: : 可要是我不够好呢？

lines.en: scene karinsushi10
: Or...the food! I meant the food! What if the food isn’t good enough?
lines.zh: : 或者……菜！我是说菜！要是菜不够好呢？

lines.en: : You’ll never want to come over again and I’ll be too embarrassed to look at you during practice!
lines.zh: : 你就再也不想来我家了，而我也会羞得在训练的时候不敢看你！

lines.en: : Then I’ll have to quit the soccer team and start pursuing another sport full time and it will destroy my future and I’ll lose any scholarship I could have gotten and...
lines.zh: : 然后我就得退出足球队，转去全职练别的项目，那会毁了我的未来，我也会失去本来能拿到的奖学金，然后……

lines.en: : And before I know it I’ll wind up severely injuring myself and never being able to play anything ever again!
lines.zh: : 然后不知不觉间，我就会受重伤，从此再也不能参加任何运动了！

lines.en: : I’m not sure how you got to the last part, but I think it might be time for us to sit down and eat.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你是怎么跳到最后那一步的，不过我想我们该坐下来吃饭了。

lines.en: : Okay! But please...{i}please{/i} stop me if I start rambling again! I mean it!
lines.zh: : 好！不过请……要是我又开始胡言乱语，{i}一定{/i}要拦住我！我说真的！

lines.en: : Sure...
scene black
Karin and I move to our respective spots at the table.
lines.zh: Karin 和我各自在桌边坐好。

lines.en: I take my place behind a plethora of beverages that she was apparently torn between-
lines.zh: 我面前摆着一大堆饮料——显然她在各种选择之间纠结过——

lines.en: And she takes her place behind...
lines.zh: 而她面前摆的是……

lines.en: : Is...is something wrong?
lines.zh: : 有、有什么问题吗？

lines.en: scene karinsushi11
: Is that a glass of wine?
lines.zh: : 那是一杯葡萄酒吗？

lines.en: : Wine?...
lines.zh: : 葡萄酒？……

lines.en: scene karinsushi12
: That’s a glass of wine.
lines.zh: : 那是一杯葡萄酒。

lines.en: : I’m not old enough to drink this.
lines.zh: : 我还不到能喝这个的年纪。

lines.en: : You're not secretly an alcoholic, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会其实是个酒鬼吧？

lines.en: scene karinsushi13
: What?! No! I must have poured it by mistake when I was pouring yours!
lines.zh: : 什么？！不是！我肯定是给你倒的时候不小心倒错了！

lines.en: : I’m only allowed to drink on special occasions!
lines.zh: : 我只在特殊场合才被允许喝酒！

lines.en: : Is today not a special occasion?
lines.zh: : 今天不算特殊场合吗？

lines.en: : It is! But...it’s a different kind of special!
lines.zh: : 算！不过……这是另一种特殊！

lines.en: : It has to be a holiday!
lines.zh: : 得是节日才行！

lines.en: : I kind of want to see you drink now.
lines.zh: : 我现在倒有点想看你喝了。

lines.en: scene karinsushi14
: Wh...why would you want to see that?
lines.zh: : 为、为什么你想看那个？

lines.en: : Just curious about how much it changes your personality.
lines.zh: : 只是好奇那会让你的性格变多少。

lines.en: : Who knows? Maybe you’re a lot more relaxed with alcohol in your system?
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢？也许喝了酒你会放松很多？

lines.en: : Please don’t say things that will lead to me having a drinking problem...
lines.zh: : 请不要说那种会害我染上酒瘾的话……

lines.en: : If I find out wine is the key to holding a conversation with you, I’ll be sneaking bottles into[school] before I know it.
lines.zh: : 要是让我发现葡萄酒是能跟你正常聊天的钥匙，我很快就会偷偷把酒瓶带进[school]了。

lines.en: : This conversation never happened.
lines.zh: : 这段对话从未发生过。

lines.en: : But...um...
: I...I wouldn’t mind if you...maybe came over for a holiday sometime...if you really wanted to see.
lines.zh: : 我……我不介意你……改天过节的时候过来……要是你真想看的话。

lines.en: : I can’t drink a lot but...it would make me happy having you around for something like that...
lines.zh: : 我喝不了多少，不过……那种时候有你在，我会很开心……

lines.en: : I’m sure it would. I can’t imagine your parents would feel the same way, though.
lines.zh: : 我相信你会。不过我想你父母大概不会这么想。

lines.en: scene karinsushi15
: Oh.
: Right.
lines.zh: : 也是。

lines.en: : I have parents.
lines.zh: : 我有父母。

lines.en: : Parents who I imagine wouldn’t be very fond of their daughter dating a staff member at the[school].
lines.zh: : 而我想，他们大概不会太乐意自己的女儿跟[school]的教职工约会。

lines.en: : Yeah...they-
lines.zh: : 是啊……他们——

lines.en: scene karinsushi16
: Wait...
lines.zh: : 等等……

lines.en: : Are...
lines.zh: : 你是说……

lines.en: : Are you saying you would...date me?
lines.zh: : 你是说你会……跟我约会？

lines.en: Shit.
lines.zh: 操。

lines.en: I guess I {i}did{/i} kind of say that.
lines.zh: 我想我{i}确实{/i}算是那么说了。

lines.en: It’s definitely not what I meant, though.
lines.zh: 不过那绝对不是我的本意。

lines.en: I mean, a relationship with Karin does sound like it would be...surprisingly normal-
lines.zh: 我是说，跟 Karin 交往听起来确实……出乎意料地正常——

lines.en: But a relationship in general isn’t something that I want.
lines.zh: 可恋爱这种事本身，并不是我想要的。

lines.en: Or at least it’s not something I think I want.
lines.zh: 又或者，至少它不是我以为自己想要的东西。

lines.en: I don’t know.
lines.zh: 我不知道。

lines.en: Maybe in a different life.
lines.zh: 也许在另一段人生里会。

lines.en: As far as this one goes, though-
lines.zh: 不过就这一段人生而言——

lines.en: : I’m sorry. I didn’t mean it like that.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我不是那个意思。

lines.en: scene karinsushi17
: Ah, no! You don’t have to apologize! I wasn’t trying to put you on the spot!
lines.zh: : 啊，不！你不用道歉！我不是想让你下不来台！

lines.en: : It just sounded like...you might...l-like me or something...that’s all...
lines.zh: : 只是听起来像是……你也许……喜、喜欢我什么的……就这样……

lines.en: : I mean, obviously you wouldn’t like someone like me. I don’t even know what kind of drinks you prefer with sushi.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，你显然不会喜欢我这样的人。我连你吃寿司喜欢配什么饮料都不知道。

lines.en: : That’s actually the first thing I quiz my prospective girlfriends on.
lines.zh: : 那其实是我考察潜在女友的第一道题。

lines.en: scene karinsushi18
: Hmm...
: What’s that face for?
lines.zh: : 你那是什么表情？

lines.en: : I’m waiting to see which one you drink first in case this ever happens again.
lines.zh: : 我在等着看你会先喝哪一瓶，万一以后还有这种机会呢。

lines.en: : Also, what other types of questions are on this quiz?
lines.zh: : 还有，这张卷子上还有什么别的题？

lines.en: : Look at you getting all serious in the face of romance.
lines.zh: : 瞧瞧你，一碰到恋爱的事就认真起来了。

lines.en: scene karinsushi19
: Oh my God! I did it! I flirted with a boy!
lines.zh: : 哦我的天！我做到了！我调戏了一个男生！

lines.en: : I'm not sure if I'd count something that small as flirting, but at least it was smooth.
lines.zh: : 我不确定这么小的事算不算调情，不过至少还算顺溜。

lines.en: : At least a lot smoother than openly celebrating your success.
lines.zh: : 至少比公开庆祝自己的成功要顺溜多了。

lines.en: scene karinsushi20
: I’m a boy expert now.
lines.zh: : 我现在是男生专家了。

lines.en: : You haven’t been sneaking sips of that wine while I’m not looking, have you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会趁我不注意偷偷喝那杯酒吧？

lines.en: scene karinsushi21
: Of course not...
lines.zh: : 当然没有……

lines.en: : But I’m...finally starting to calm down, I think.
lines.zh: : 不过我……总算开始冷静下来了，我想。

lines.en: : My heart’s still beating out of my chest, but...I think that “dating” thing gave me a temporary boost to my self-esteem.
lines.zh: : 我的心还是快跳出胸口，不过……那个“约会”的说法，大概暂时给我打了一针自信。

lines.en: : Even though I immediately said I didn’t mean anything by it?
lines.zh: : 尽管我马上就说了那不是我的本意？

lines.en: : Weird, right? Maybe that part just hasn’t settled in yet?
lines.zh: : 很怪，对吧？也许那部分还没反应过来？

lines.en: : Or maybe I’m just finally-
lines.zh: : 又或者我总算是——

lines.en: scene karinsushi22
: Wait. No. It’s here.
lines.zh: : 等等。不。来了。

lines.en: : I’m going to die alone with ten cats.
lines.zh: : 我将来会跟十只猫一起孤独地死掉。

lines.en: : No one is truly alone with ten cats.
lines.zh: : 有十只猫在，就不算真正的孤独。

lines.en: scene karinsushi23
: Do you like cats, Sensei?!
lines.zh: : 老师你喜欢猫吗？！

lines.en: : Not really.
lines.zh: : 不太喜欢。

lines.en: scene karinsushi24
: Oh.
: But...their ears.
lines.zh: : 可是……它们的耳朵。

lines.en: : And their little noses...
lines.zh: : 还有它们小小的鼻子……

lines.en: : I just meant that all human beings are inherently alone as a matter of principle, so the only way to properly judge loneliness is by sheer tangibility.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，原则上所有人本质上都是孤独的，所以衡量孤独的唯一标准，只能是实实在在的可触之物。

lines.en: : If there are ten other living creatures in the same room as you, whether they be cats or humans, you are not {i}technically{/i} alone.
lines.zh: : 要是同一个房间里还有另外十个活物，不管是猫还是人，{i}严格来说{/i}你就不算孤身一人。

lines.en: : But you {i}are{/i} still alone.
lines.zh: : 但你依然{i}是{/i}孤独的。

lines.en: : Get it?
lines.zh: : 懂了吗？

lines.en: scene karinsushi25
: But...their ears...
lines.zh: : 可是……它们的耳朵……

lines.en: : And their little noses...
lines.zh: : 还有它们小小的鼻子……

lines.en: : Let’s just eat now...
lines.zh: : 我们还是先吃饭吧……

lines.en: scene black
I decide to stop being depressing for a moment and enjoy the food Karin prepared for us.
lines.zh: 我决定暂时不再丧气，好好享受 Karin 为我们准备的食物。

lines.en: I’m surprised she was able to make something as classy as a sushi platter with virtually no mistakes whatsoever.
lines.zh: 我很意外，她居然能把寿司拼盘这种讲究的东西做得几乎毫无瑕疵。

lines.en: I’m not even sure if Ami can make sushi at this level, and she’s pretty much a personal chef at this point.
lines.zh: 我都不确定 Ami 能不能做出这个水平的寿司，而她现在基本算是个私人厨师了。

lines.en: I guess if anyone was going to be able to, though, it was Karin.
lines.zh: 不过要说有谁能做到，那大概就是 Karin 了。

lines.en: Despite her tomboyish hobbies and a physique that would make even professional athletes jealous, she’s a pure, wholesome girl at heart.
lines.zh: 尽管她有着男孩子气的爱好，还有一副连职业运动员都会嫉妒的体格，她的内心依然是个纯洁、健康的女孩。

lines.en: A wholesome girl who wants to make the people around her happy, and who wants to find happiness of her own without damaging anyone else in the process.
lines.zh: 一个想让身边的人都开心，也想在不伤害任何人的前提下找到自己幸福的、健康的女孩。

lines.en: I wish her luck in that regard.
lines.zh: 这方面我祝她好运。

lines.en: Personally, I don’t think something like that is possible.
lines.zh: 就我个人而言，我觉得那是不可能的。

lines.en: But I’d be happy to be proven wrong.
lines.zh: 不过我很乐意被证明是错的。

$ karindate15 = True
{i}Karin’s affection has increased to [karin_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Karin 的好感度提升到了 [karin_love]！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Thirty minutes later...I leave Karin’s house and decide to get on with my day...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}三十分钟后……我离开 Karin 家，决定继续我的一天……{/i}
